name: Autonomous Creator Agents
postCreateCommand: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd backend && alembic upgrade head
postStartCommand: cd backend && (pkill -f 'uvicorn app.main' || true) && nohup uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/aca-server.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; tail -n 5 /tmp/aca-server.log
